selection: Use only the original MNIST expert, public anchor, MNIST head and the already inspected MNIST development subset. Profile 24 single Attention/MLP resets and 12 same-layer joint resets. Starting with all 24 modules reset, greedily remove the smallest single-module-cost first (ties layer then component), while maintaining at least 5 pp standalone task loss. Repeat until no single removal is feasible or the 80-variant budget is exhausted. Inclusion minimality is conditional on this threshold and subset, not global minimum cardinality.
confirmation: Freeze the selected support and its SHA256 before loading SVHN. Evaluate standalone MNIST and the matched public-support-reset fusion on a new disjoint 4000-image MNIST training subset. SVHN is evaluation-only; it cannot affect support selection.
purpose: Necessary-support audit, not a protection candidate. If full replacement of the selected support restores high fusion utility, any same-support postprocessing has that public recovery floor.
